blurb: Offers recreational dance classes for ages 3-18 in hip hop, ballet, tap/jazz, jazz/contemporary, breakdancing, and gymnastics. Also offers classes for adults, birthday parties with dance or tumbling instruction, studio room rentals, private lessons, and competitive dance teams (Company and Crew). Tuition is monthly or yearly with discounts for multiple classes.
extraNote: Tuition paid monthly or year-in-full; discounts for multiple classes per family · 3% transaction fee for credit card payments, 1.25% for ACH payments; cash/check no fees · Tuition due by 1st of month; $15 late fee after 7th; dancers may be removed if unpaid · No refunds for missed classes due to personal reasons, weather, holidays, rehearsals, recital · Five dancers minimum to maintain a class; refunds or credits if class cancelled for low enrollment
